business: TextilWorld (online fabric by the meter, Poland)
by_segment: Small clothing-brand owner or home seamstress selling online
why_not: For sets and decor I need to feel the drape and see the colour under light before I commit to 20 metres, so I go to my local fabric shop first. I'd only look at an online shop like this if my shop ran out, and nothing here tells me it's better than what I already use.
I already have a fabric shop I trust and they know what I need, so I have no reason to gamble on a new one. 14.90 for black viscose is fine, but it isn't cheap enough to make me switch.

When I need fabric it's for a set order date, and nothing here tells me what's actually in stock or how fast it leaves the warehouse. I'm not going to bet a client deadline on a shop I don't know when my usual Allegro sellers show stock and Smart delivery up front.

I have a wedding job due next month and I can't gamble on a shop I don't know. Nothing here says they offer swatches or real daylight photos, or tells me what's actually in stock, so I'll stick with the supplier whose colours I already trust.

I buy plain black viscose at my local fabric shop, where I can hold it and see how it falls. I only order online when the shop doesn't have something, and plain black viscose isn't one of those things.

Nothing here stops my scroll: it's a price list with plain black viscose, not a creator draping it or showing it in a set. For decor I buy in bigger runs, and I'm not ordering 20 metres from a shop I've never seen fabric from.
why_yes: 14.90 for black viscose is a decent price, so if their Allegro listing comes up cheapest with Smart delivery I'd add it to the cart. I wouldn't go to their own website though, and I'm not loyal to them, I'm loyal to the cheapest offer that week.

At 14.90 a metre for black viscose, 20 metres is about 300 PLN, so the locker delivery stops mattering. That's a fair price, so I'd try one run's worth, probably through Allegro so I'm covered if the colour or weight is off.
